summary: The red-team result has no findings, so there is no verdict to give. Its clean result is accepted only in part. Its checks of the fourteen links hold: every endpoint is an atlas stage, all 29 link quotations are literal substrings of the current stage descriptions, all fourteen pairs are production edges and populate the consumers' requires lists, the union of the assembled graph, every research link map and all requires entries (8,118 edges) is acyclic, and the spot-checked reasons (HopfRinow 1 → LG0, LG4 → GeometricTopology 10, LG5 → GeometricTopology 8, LG7 → ShimuraData D2) are correctly scoped. The map makes no library claim, and the named Mathlib interfaces I spot-checked exist at 082e2d3 while no Frobenius integrability theorem exists at either pin, so the LG4 supply is substantive. Its conclusion that the 'five sibling arrows remain correctly recorded' is not accepted. Three of the five alreadyRecorded pairs (UniversalCovers 0 → LG5, UniversalCovers 1 → LG5, CompactGroups 0 → LG6) live only in partial, unreviewed research packets with no data/links copy, so they never reach the atlas; the REV-LINK review actively removed CompactGroups 0 → LG6 from this map's links on that basis. The red team's own checked list records the fact (sixteen production edges touch LieGroups: the fourteen plus two RootSystems) without drawing the conclusion. This missed issue is recorded as an observation for independent follow-up, following the RT-LINK-tauceti_Completed_OrthogonalL2Bases precedent; it is not a confirmed finding and generates no fix job by itself.

observations.evidence: At 75003a68, scripts.build.assemble(require_distances=False) run in memory gives 2,840 stages and 8,007 distinct stage edges. All six endpoints are atlas stages. None of the three pairs is an edge, and with requires included there is no forward or reverse path between their endpoints; the two RootSystems alreadyRecorded pairs are direct edges. The only links entries for the three pairs are in research/blueprint/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_UniversalCovers.json (blob 1b51d8a0, status partial, no review block) and research/blueprint/links/tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_RepresentationTheory_CompactGroups.json (blob dbc84805, status partial, no review block); data/links has neither file. Their link jobs #70 and #59 are state:available and their reviews #137 and #126 are state:blocked. build.assemble loads only data/links, and merge_links refuses packets without an accepted review and reads only packet['links'], so alreadyRecorded is never merged. The REV-LINK review removed CompactGroups 0 → LG6 from this map ('Same valid dependency already recorded in the CompactGroups sibling packet'), so an accepted production edge was replaced by a research-only record. All six sibling quotations are literal substrings of the current stage descriptions. merge_links of exactly the three sibling links gives 8,010 edges; merging them a second time also gives 8,010, and the cycle check passes. Mathematically the pairs are sound: LG5 needs the based simply connected cover and lifting (UC 0) and the deck-group/π₁ identification (UC 1) for connected Lie groups; LG6's Weyl integration formula uses the normalized Haar probability measures on G and T (CG 0).
observations.proposedCorrection: Record this as a new red-team finding and obtain independent verification. Then add the three pairs to the links array of the accepted LieGroups packet, with the sibling packets' source, target, confidence and evidence and their scope-limiting reasons (UC 0/1: LieGroups still lifts the group operations and proves centrality; CG 0: no torus existence, conjugacy, root Jacobian or Weyl integration is supplied), restore the removed CompactGroups entry, and retag or remove alreadyRecorded[2..4] so they no longer read as covered. Correct the summary and review narrative accordingly, obtain renewed independent acceptance and promote normally. Do not promote or accept the partial sibling packets, and do not edit the generated graph by hand. merge_links deduplicates ordered pairs, so a later promotion of the sibling packets stays harmless.
